reason: As this lapsed donor, I'm more likely to give after reading B. It thanks me, admits the Eastside closure hurt, and doesn't promise that every child will get a place. It also promises a February report on how many of the 61 children started lessons, which helps rebuild trust. A's P.S. says the foundation will match "whatever you give" without mentioning the $15,000 cap, which would make me wary.
